summary: WF Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K with a notice of extraordinary general meeting to approve a share restructuring. Proposals include increasing authorized share capital from $50,000 to $25 billion (100 trillion ordinary shares), creating a new Class A share with 100 votes each convertible 1:1 into ordinary shares, and redesignating 10 trillion ordinary shares into Class A shares held by key shareholders. The special resolution adopts amended articles. This is a capital structure change to consolidate control, not an acquisition, tender, or other special situation. Watch for shareholder approval at the July 10, 2026 meeting; no price/per-share terms or advisor named.
